responsibility: The view for an axonometric sheet from a Rhino 9 model: camera and projection, exclusions and cut-away crop, hidden-line occlusion, joint and detail-cut selection, and the building lock, handing linework to rhino-thinline.
inputs: The open Rhino 9 document reached through the Rhino AI panel's Rhino tools, the user's request and the output folder they name. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only for a requested PDF of a layout, written through rhino-thinline's export and read back by its PDF check. Also this skill's lessons, appended in the plugin data folder the startup line names.
